A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Make like fractions
skills.definition: Rewrite fractional parts so they share a common denominator or align a whole number as a mixed form with 0 over the needed denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align whole and fractional parts for subtraction.
Tag when a mixed-number problem first adjusts fractional parts to a shared denominator before subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting is done.
Do not tag for normalizing an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2; that is not denominator alignment.
Do not tag the actual subtraction step after equivalent forms are already written.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Convert a nonstandard mixed-number expression with an improper fractional part into a standard whole-plus-proper-fraction form before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 5/3 is rewritten as an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly states 'normalize' and carries extra wholes from the improper fraction part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator.
Do not tag for borrowing during subtraction.
Do not tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that belongs to denominator alignment.

skills.name: Subtract without borrowing
skills.definition: Subtract aligned fractions or separated whole and fractional parts directly when no regrouping from the whole part is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of like fractions directly.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately and the fractional result is nonnegative without borrowing.
Tag when the result is then combined from already-subtracted whole and fractional parts without any regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the solver must borrow/regroup because the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
Do not tag for simplification only.
Do not tag for preparatory conversion to common denominators or standard mixed form.

skills.name: Borrow and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units to complete subtraction when the fractional part is too small, and reduce any resulting fraction or zero to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-sized fractional units.
Tag when subtraction continues after borrowing, such as turning 1 into 5/5 or 12/12 and then subtracting fractions.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fractional result or 0-form result to lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed directly with no regrouping and no simplification step is shown.
Do not tag for merely finding a common denominator.
Do not tag for normalizing an improper mixed number before subtraction.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Make fraction parts comparable by finding a common denominator and rewriting equivalent fractions, including rewriting a whole number as 0 over a chosen denominator when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a fraction is converted to an equivalent fraction with a new denominator before subtraction.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align fraction parts for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no denominator-alignment rewrite is performed.
Do not tag for normalizing an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2; that is not denominator equalization.
Do not tag for borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a standard whole-plus-proper-fraction form before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly states 'normalize' or rewrites the mixed number by carrying whole units out of the fraction part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/d.
Do not tag for finding common denominators among proper fractions.
Do not tag for borrowing 1 from the whole part during subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract the quantities once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole and fraction parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers or mixed/whole combinations.
Tag when the subtraction produces a zero whole part, zero fraction part, or a negative fractional interim result before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the preparatory step of finding a common denominator or rewriting forms.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag for simplifying the final result to lowest terms.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing 1 from the whole part when the fractional subtraction is negative, and/or reduce the resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms in the final answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to d/d to continue fraction subtraction.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when the solution simplifies 0/d to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for ordinary subtraction that does not require borrowing and does not include simplification.
Do not tag for initial normalization of improper mixed numbers.
Do not tag for finding a common denominator before subtraction.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Make fraction parts comparable by finding a common denominator and rewriting equivalent fractions, including rewriting a whole number as 0 over a chosen denominator when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a fraction is converted to an equivalent fraction with a new denominator before subtraction.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align fraction parts for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no denominator-matching rewrite is performed.
Do not tag simple separation of whole and fractional parts unless a denominator-alignment rewrite is actually shown.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2; that belongs to a different skill.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution changes a form like 2 3/2 into 3 1/2.
Tag when the solution explicitly carries whole units out of an improper fraction part in a mixed number.
Tag when this normalization is done before any subtraction steps.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary mixed-number decomposition such as 3 1/8 = 3 + 1/8.
Do not tag borrowing during subtraction; borrowing is a separate operation.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create common denominators.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of like-denominator fractions.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers after setup is complete.
Tag when the subtraction may temporarily produce a negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create common denominators or rewrite forms before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a whole into fractional units.
Do not tag final simplification or reduction after subtraction.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve subtraction results by borrowing one whole into fractional units when needed and reduce or express the final result in lowest terms, integer, fraction, or mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from a whole part and converts it to d/d to continue fraction subtraction.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when the solution combines whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or recognizes a zero fraction as an integer result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction steps that occur before any regrouping or simplification.
Do not tag denominator-finding or equivalent-fraction conversion.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
